product_description: Tall stoneware vase with a narrow neck and a matte ivory glaze. Plain and undecorated, so it suits a few branches on an entry table or a single stem on a shelf.
Relaxed long-sleeve shirt in ivory linen with shell buttons. Light and slightly textured, it works tucked into trousers for the office or worn open over a tee on the weekend.
Weekend bag in dark brown full-grain leather with a canvas lining and brass hardware. Room for two or three days of clothes, and the leather softens and darkens as you use it.
Hand-poured soy candle with santal, fig leaf, and cedarwood. 60-hour burn time in a reusable amber glass vessel.
Rectangular watch with a brushed steel case, a white dial with plain markers and a tan leather strap. Slim enough to sit under a shirt cuff, and easy to wear every day.
Neroli oil in a small clear glass bottle with a dropper. The scent is light and fresh, like orange blossom.
Set of four placemats woven from natural jute. They stand up to everyday meals, add texture to a plain wooden table, and only need a shake and a brush after dinner.
Two-piece lounge set in pre-washed oat linen: a relaxed top and drawstring trousers. Soft from the first wear, for weekends at home and warm evenings.
Lightweight knit sneakers in stone gray with a cushioned foam sole. Breathable on warm days and comfortable enough for errands, commutes and short runs.
Cream washed canvas tote with tan leather handles. Roomy and light, it carries a laptop, groceries or a beach towel, and the canvas gets softer with use.
Short-sleeve camp-collar shirt in deep indigo linen. Relaxed fit and pre-washed, so it is soft from day one and stays cool on hot travel days.
Waxed canvas dopp kit with a brass zipper. Water-resistant lining. Sized for a carry-on.
Slim card wallet in full-grain vegetable-tanned leather. Four slots, one center pocket. Ages beautifully.
Lightweight drawstring trousers in pre-washed oat linen. Tapered leg and deep pockets, easy to pack and cool on long travel days.
Espadrille slides with a natural jute sole and a tan leather footbed. Easy to slip on for the beach, the pool or a warm evening out, and light enough to pack.
Linen-cotton blend overshirt in sage green. Relaxed fit, chest pocket. A layer that earns its keep.
Full-grain leather holdall with brass buckles. Canvas-lined interior, padded base. Built for 48 hours.
Cotton-linen blend crew neck tee in cream. Pre-washed for softness, with a slightly textured weave that stays cool in the heat.
Woven straw panama hat with a black grosgrain ribbon. Light and breathable, for sunny days at the beach, in the garden or on a city walk.
Three pairs of merino wool crew socks in charcoal, oat and olive. Temperature-regulating, odor-resistant.
Set of four hand-poured beeswax tapers. Clean burn, subtle honey scent. Arrives tied with cotton twine.
Set of four soft white linen napkins with hemstitched edges. They arrive gift-boxed, ready to give.
Small hand-thrown ceramic ring dish in speckled cream glaze. For the bedside, the vanity, the windowsill.
Silk scarf printed with sage leaves and terracotta flowers on cream, with hand-rolled edges. Wear it at the neck, tie it to a bag handle or use it in your hair.
Matte black glass reed diffuser with natural rattan sticks. Neroli and sandalwood. Lasts 3 months.
Three handmade soap bars in a small wooden box: lavender, oat milk and honey. Tied with cord and ready to give, and each bar lasts a few weeks at the sink.
Small ceramic bud vase in dusty rose glaze. For a single stem on a desk, a shelf, a bedside table.
Leather-bound journal with hand-stitched spine. 192 pages of cream laid paper. Refillable.
Hammered brass photo frame, 5x7. Stands or hangs. The kind of frame that makes a photo feel kept.
Cream tissue paper, blush satin ribbon, kraft gift tags with cotton string. Enough for three gifts.
Stoneware pour-over dripper and carafe in an ash gray glaze. Brew two cups of coffee by hand and take your time over breakfast at the kitchen table.
Raw linen throw blanket in natural flax. Gets softer with every wash. For the chair, the sofa, the bed.
Olive wood cutting board with a handle and a grain that varies from board to board. Slice bread, fruit and cheese for a long weekend breakfast, then serve straight from it.
Unglazed terracotta planter with drainage hole. Develops a natural patina over months.
Brushed brass incense holder with a single channel that holds one stick upright. Small enough for a shelf or windowsill, and the brass darkens a little over time.
Set of two hand-thrown ceramic tumblers in a speckled charcoal glaze, no two exactly alike. Good for juice at breakfast, water at dinner or iced coffee on a warm afternoon.
Stoneware bowl in matte cream with deliberate imperfections. For the morning granola, the evening soup.
Thick beeswax pillar candle, hand-dipped. Burns for 80 hours. The uneven surface is the point.
Linen table runner in natural, undyed flax. It softens with every wash and runs down the middle of the table for weeknight dinners or long meals with friends.
Black soap bar made with activated charcoal. A deep-cleaning bar for face and body that lathers well and rinses clean, handmade in small batches.
Hand-shaped lacquered ceramic catchall with an organic wavy rim and a high-gloss coral glaze. For keys, rings, and the small things that otherwise go missing.
Waffle-weave cotton bath robe in muted sage. Long-staple cotton that softens with every wash, with patch pockets and a self-tie belt.
Collarless vest in diamond-quilted washed silk. Light as a layer, warm as a coat lining, cut to wear open over knitwear.
Wall clock cut from a single piece of honed travertine. No numerals, two slim brushed-brass hands, a silent movement.
Single-breasted blazer in charcoal wool flannel. Half-canvassed, notch lapel, working cuffs. Tailored in a wool that holds its line.
Fringed throw in an ivory cashmere and wool blend. Soft and warm without much weight, it sits folded at the end of the bed or over the sofa for cold evenings.
Eau de parfum of vetiver, dry cedar and a little smoked vanilla, in an amber glass bottle. Woody and calm, it stays close to the skin.
Market tote in full-grain vegetable-tanned leather, with an unlined interior, rolled handles and saddle stitching. The leather develops a patina with use.
Stonewashed linen bedding in flax: a duvet cover and two pillowcases. Breathable in summer, warm enough in winter, and it gets softer with each wash.
Lightweight merino wool crewneck in oat. Warm without bulk, resists odor, and thin enough to layer under a blazer or over a collared shirt.
Full-length overcoat in a camel wool blend. Notch lapel, patch pockets and a straight cut that fits over a suit jacket or a thick sweater through the coldest months.
Bias-cut slip dress in warm off-white silk. It skims the body rather than clinging, and works on its own in summer or under a knit when the weather cools.
High-waisted trouser in chalk wool with a double forward pleat and a turned cuff. Cut wide through the leg, tapered at the hem.
Chelsea boot in tobacco calf suede on a stacked leather heel. Goodyear-welted, so it can be resoled rather than replaced.
Eau de parfum of green fig, cedar, and warm milk. Opens sharp and settles into something closer to skin.
Body oil of rose absolute, squalane, and apricot kernel. The scent fades to a clean sweetness.
Oversized wrap in an oat cashmere and wool blend that doubles as an airplane blanket. Rolls to the size of a paperback and ties with a flat linen ribbon.
Signet ring in gold-plated sterling silver with a brushed finish and a blank oval face. Left plain so it can be engraved later, and comfortable for everyday wear.
Flat-woven wool rug in undyed sand with a tonal border. With no pile, it lies flat under chairs, vacuums easily and suits a living room or bedroom floor.
Mouth-blown glass decanter with a slightly irregular neck and small bubbles in the glass. Holds a bottle of wine, or water for the dinner table.
Field watch with a round 38 mm brushed stainless steel case, a cream dial with plain hour markers and an olive green canvas strap. Easy to read at a glance and light on the wrist.
Tan full-grain leather roll with three slots and a snap closure. Keeps watches or bracelets from scratching in a bag, and makes an easy gift for someone who travels.
Ribbed wool beanie in rust orange with a folded cuff. Warm on cold walks and commutes, and it folds small enough for a coat pocket.
Rounded square sunglasses with a tortoiseshell acetate frame and green-tinted glass lenses. A classic shape for driving, beach days and city walks.
Two stoneware mugs in a matte speckled oat glaze. Each holds a big cup of coffee or tea, with a handle wide enough to wrap your fingers around on a lazy weekend.
Clear glass carafe that holds one liter, with a small tumbler that sits on top as its lid. Keeps water on the breakfast table or by the bed, with a glass ready to pour.
Small round salt cellar in a terracotta red glaze, with a light wooden spoon. Keeps flaky salt within reach by the stove or on the table for eggs, tomatoes and toast.
Five-quart round Dutch oven in enameled cast iron, sage green outside and cream inside. Holds heat evenly for soups, stews and bread, and goes from stovetop to oven to table.
Tall brushed stainless steel pot with two side handles and a glass lid. Holds eight quarts, enough for pasta for a crowd, a big batch of soup or homemade broth.
Kitchen apron in natural flax linen with cross-back straps that keep the weight off your neck and one front pocket. Washes well and softens the more you wear it.
Pair of salad servers carved from dark walnut. Long enough to reach the bottom of a big bowl, and a quick hand wash and an occasional rub of oil keep them smooth.
Four glossy ceramic espresso cups with matching saucers, one each in cobalt, mustard, sage and terracotta. Each holds a single or double shot.
Three cloth-bound A5 notebooks with dot-grid pages, one each in navy, ochre and sage. Use one for lists, one for notes and one for sketches.
Capped rollerball pen made of solid brass with a brushed finish. It writes smoothly, fits a jacket pocket, and the brass darkens a little as you use it.
Rectangular desk tray in dark brown leather with snapped corners. Holds keys, coins and earbuds by the door, or pens and clips on a desk.
Eight folded cards in heavyweight cream paper, each with a simple botanical line drawing, plus kraft envelopes. Blank inside for birthdays, thank-you notes or just saying hello.
Three rolls of recycled kraft wrapping paper in terracotta, navy and natural, all with small white dots. Sturdy enough for books and boxes, and easy to recycle again afterward.
Square photo album with oatmeal linen-covered boards and a small window on the cover for a photo or label. Room for a year of prints from trips, birthdays and family visits.
Housewarming gift box in natural kraft with a linen tea towel, a ceramic mug and a wooden spoon, packed in cream tissue. Ready to give to someone moving into a new place.
Soy wax candle in an amber glass jar, with a soft scent of coffee, orange peel and brown sugar. Burns for about 40 hours, and the jar makes a pencil cup afterward.
Table lamp with a matte white ceramic base and a natural linen shade. Gives a soft, warm light for reading in a chair or by the bed, and suits a side table or dresser.
Two square linen cushion covers, one in rust and one in oat, with zip closures. Inserts are not included. Pull them off to machine wash, and the linen softens with each wash.
Three nesting baskets in natural seagrass, with handles. Use them for blankets, shoes or toys, and they make a useful housewarming gift for a first apartment.
Chunky wool throw in a moss green herringbone with a fringed edge. Warm enough for winter evenings on the sofa, and a generous housewarming gift for a new home.
Chore jacket in sturdy indigo cotton canvas with three patch pockets and plain buttons. Wear it as a light layer in spring and fall, and it softens and fades with each wash.
Heather gray crewneck sweatshirt in soft cotton fleece, with no print or logo. Easy to throw on for errands, workouts or a quiet day at home.
Oatmeal cotton knit cardigan with wooden buttons. Light enough for air-conditioned offices and cool evenings, and it washes without fuss.
Straight-leg chinos in stone cotton twill. Neat enough for the office and relaxed enough for weekends, and they hold their shape wash after wash.
Hooded rain jacket in lightweight mustard yellow nylon, with a small stuff sack to pack it into. Keeps off showers on city walks and hikes, and weighs next to nothing in a bag.
Lightweight polyester running shorts in navy with white piping. They dry quickly and have a zip pocket for a key, for early runs before work or a gym session.
Low-top sneakers in off-white cotton canvas on white rubber soles. Simple enough to wear with jeans, chinos or a summer dress, every day of the week.
Penny loafers in tobacco brown suede. Soft from the first wear, they dress up chinos or jeans and slip on without socks in summer.
Ankle-height rain boots in forest green natural rubber with elastic side panels. Easy to pull on for wet commutes, dog walks and the garden.
Three packing cubes in slate blue nylon with mesh tops, in small, medium and large. Keep shirts, socks and chargers sorted in a suitcase or carry-on.
Small crossbody bag in olive waxed canvas with leather trim and an adjustable strap. Holds a phone, wallet, passport and keys, and shrugs off light rain.
Zip-top backpack in charcoal waxed canvas with leather details. Room for a laptop, a jacket and lunch, and the waxed canvas handles a rainy commute or a day of travel.

Four squeezable silicone travel bottles in clear, sage, sand and blue, each holding 3 fl oz (about 90 ml), with a clear zip pouch. Sized for carry-on bags, with enough shampoo or lotion for a week away.
Tan leather passport wallet with card slots and room for a boarding pass. Keeps travel documents together and slips into a jacket or bag pocket.
Two bath towels and two hand towels in white cotton terry with a thin sage stripe. Soft and absorbent, they dry quickly and hold up to frequent washing.
Bath mat in oat cotton waffle weave. It soaks up water quickly, dries fast between showers, and goes in the washing machine with your towels.
